context: A mom helps her young son go through his class schedule
purpose: Teach: 月曜日/火曜日/三月/校長/分間/半ば/長男/国語

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、月曜日の時間割を一緒に確認しようか。
lines.en: Sho, let's check Monday's class schedule together.
lines.style: Gentle motherly tone, calm and encouraging morning voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 月曜日は最初が国語の授業だよ。漢字のテストがあるの。
lines.en: Monday starts with Japanese class. There's a kanji test.
lines.style: Bright young boy, slightly nervous about the kanji test.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 国語の漢字テストか、頑張ってね。火曜日は何があるの?
lines.en: A kanji test in Japanese class, do your best. What's on Tuesday?
lines.style: Warm and supportive, gently moving through the weekly schedule.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 火曜日は体育で、十分間走をするんだ。
lines.en: Tuesday is PE, and we do a ten-minute run.
lines.style: Excited child voice, energetic about physical education class.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 十分間走?すごいね。あ、三月半ばに発表会もあったよね。
lines.en: A ten-minute run? Impressive. Oh, there's also a recital in mid-March.
lines.style: Impressed motherly tone, then suddenly remembering an upcoming event.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、三月の発表会では校長先生がお話するんだって。
lines.en: Yeah, the principal will give a speech at March's recital.
lines.style: Informative child voice, repeating what his teacher said earlier.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 校長先生のお話、しっかり聞いてきてね。お母さんも見に行くから。
lines.en: Listen carefully to the principal's speech. I'll come watch too.
lines.style: Encouraging and warm, showing maternal support for the event.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うちの長男の発表、楽しみにしててね!ピアノも頑張るよ。
lines.en: Look forward to your eldest son's performance! I'll do my best at piano too.
lines.style: Proud determined child voice, playfully referring to himself.
